label: sdc01_0360_sister_01
text: Knock it off, all of you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_02
text: They were trying to go three against one on you,\nhuh? I guess a fair fight’s too much to expect![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_04
text: We’ll make you regret ever coming back to life![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_05
text: Hmph! I guess I’m just too much for them to\nhandle![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_brother_03
text: A-about the mask. I just got so angry, and...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0360_brother_04
text: What I did was real dumb...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_07
text: He was sulkin’ around, so I grabbed him by the\ncollar and dragged him here![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_brother_07
text: It’s really you... The real-life ogre...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_09
text: You wanted to be the one to give the mask back\nto Ogerpon, right, Kiki?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_10
text: It seems scared... Maybe it’s not good with new\npeople, Kiki.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_brother_11
text: I don’t think it’ll take the mask if I’m the one\ngiving it back. You should be the one to do it,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0360_system_01
text: You returned the Teal Mask to Ogerpon!

label: sdc01_0360_sister_11
text: Hee hee, it seems so happy![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_13
text: It’d be nice if we could give the other three\nmasks back to Ogerpon too, don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_brother_13
text: Did those... Did those three Pokémon take the\nmasks that were in Kitakami Hall?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_14
text: Yeah! Never mind that the masks rightfully belong\nto poor Ogerpon here![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_15
text: I wouldn’t put it past the so-called Loyal Three\nto plot a second ambush, either. We need to\r\nkeep Ogerpon safe while we deal with them![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_16
text: That means the three of us are gonna form a\nteam—the Mask Retrieval Squad![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_17
text: Good idea, isn’t it? And you get to be my\nsecond-in-command![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_18
text: You got a problem with the name? Think carefully\nor I may demote you from second-in-command![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_19
text: Of course you can!\c\nAnd now that that’s settled, let’s go gather\nintel about those “Loyal” Three in Mossui![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_sister_20
text: We’re gonna get those masks back![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0360_system_02
text: Ogerpon will now follow you around!

label: sdc01_0360_caretaker_01
text: With the Loyal Three walking among us again,\nthis might be a good chance to capitalize on\r\nsome new merch and souvenirs for the town![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
